# Strategic Licensing for LLM Outputs

This project strictly adheres to a completely free license model. By **not using any externally cloned data**, we aim to minimize legal ambiguity. This strategic decision ensures that the inference results output by LLMs, including the tokenizer and weight data derived from this model, will themselves be freely licensed.

**Consequently**, creating the raw corpus data and categorized dictionaries **is a highly time-consuming process.**

If you'd like to support this mission, we would be grateful for your help in data creation or categorization.

Please feel free to contact me, Minashi Sora.

Thank you :)
